Synopsis:
Dialogue with Mayrina after she is cured from the hag curse. In the dialogue she gives hag research book that makes hag fight easier (there is the scroll of Burning Pearls inside), provides her husband reactivity based on how players handled him in Act 1 and may give players the quest reward for killing the hag

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_HagSurvivors_SurrogateMother_Cured.json: Mayrina is a former hag victim who was recently cured of a hex (she’d been turned into a sheep if present) and now leads a small support group of hag survivors hunting a new hag in the city. Off‑screen a redcap spy (Jatlo) infiltrated the group and planted a bewitched voodoo doll that either hexed Mayrina or frightened the others; the player may already have exposed or destroyed that doll or slain the spy. In gratitude or to help with the coming confrontation, Mayrina can hand over a hag‑research book (it contains a scroll of Burning Pearls that makes the hag fight easier) and may give the player the quest reward for killing the hag. Her husband’s tone and reaction in this scene will vary depending on how the player treated him in Act I.
- LOW_HagSurvivors_Adrielle.json: Default dialogue for Adrielle, one of the hag support group players can meet in the Lower city. The hag support group is made up of people who have survived an encouter with a hag, and who have banded together to try to research hags, but also to be there for one another. However, one of their group (the dragonborn), is secretly a redcap and is toying with their minds. The redcap has also, if Mayrina is present, hexed her and turned her into a sheep. If Mayrina isn't present, the redcap has enchanted a doll that is terrifying the group.This dialogue covers a number of states such as 1) Mayrina is present and has been hexed 2) player cured her 3) player has saved Adrielle and the others from a redcap 4) the hag is dead and Adrielle rewards them (if no other npc is present) 5) if mayrina isn't present, a doll is terrorising them and she's trying to find it
- LOW_HagSurvivors_Kleidunn.json: Default dialogue for Kled, one of the hag support group players can meet in the Lower city. The hag support group is made up of people who have survived an encouter with a hag, and who have banded together to try to research hags, but also to be there for one another. However, one of their group (the dragonborn), is secretly a redcap and is toying with their minds. The redcap has also, if Mayrina is present, hexed her and turned her into a sheep. If Mayrina isn't present, the redcap has enchanted a doll that is terrifying the group.This dialogue covers a number of states such as 1) Mayrina is present and has been hexed 2) player cured her 3) player has saved kled and the others from a redcap 4) the hag is dead and kled rewards them (if no other npc is present) 5) if mayrina isn't present, a doll is terrorising them and he's trying to find it
- LOW_HagSurvivors_MaskedVictim1.json: Hydrangea (the “Mask of Regret”) is one of a small Lower City support group made up of people who survived hag attacks and now study and watch for hags. Off‑screen a redcap spy named Jatlo slipped into their midst—disguised as a dragonborn—and planted a bewitched doll that either hexed Mayrina into a sheep or, if Mayrina wasn’t present, popped up to terrorize the survivors. The player has arrived and likely cured Mayrina or destroyed the doll (or otherwise exposed or killed the spy), prompting Hydrangea’s angry, guilty reaction. She also possesses a hag’s book and fears that keeping it will make the hag hunt her forever, which fuels her panic, suspicion, and reluctance to be drawn into more trouble.
- LOW_HagSurvivors_HagSpy.json: A redcap in hag disguise has been planted among the hag survivors as a spy. He sent a bewitched doll that taunts and scares the others — if Mayrina is present the doll was used to hex her into a sheep; if she isn’t, it merely pops up to torment the survivors. The spy is cold, accusatory, and tries to deflect blame onto the player to hide his role in the doll’s mischief. The narrator’s note that he looks like one of the hags but “smells of blood and moss” hints that his disguise is imperfect. The player has arrived either to investigate or to help Mayrina and is being watched and questioned by this suspicious spy.
